subject: Procurement readiness + marketplace options — billing path decision
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Langford <sarah.langford@finflow.com>, procurement@finflow.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & marketplace options

Hi Sarah / FinFlow team,

Thanks for the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness:

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time document summarization for customer support (low-latency, token-heavy).
- Anticipated steady state: ~2M tokens/month, spiky on weekdays.
- Data handling: logs to be retained 30 days; customer data not stored beyond inference except audit logs.

Commercial paths we discussed:
1) AWS Marketplace (preferred by FinFlow) — subscription billing, centralized procurement, faster internal approvals for many teams.
2) Paper PO / SOW + invoice — supports corporate card/PO process, longer lead time but flexible SLA/custom terms.
3) Direct credit-card self-serve — fastest but not aligned with procurement controls.

Action items / asks:
- Sarah: confirm whether Finance/Procurement wants us to pursue Marketplace listing now or they prefer PO paperwork (reply with explicit preference).
- Procurement: share any standard checklist or contract terms we should expect (NDA/SLA/insurance limits).
- Redwood (Dev / Marissa): I can prepare an initial SLA + marketplace listing checklist; if PO path is needed, we'll draft SOW + invoice template.

Attachments I will prepare: SLA draft, marketplace onboarding checklist.

Proposed next step: Sarah, could you confirm procurement preference by EOD Tuesday so we can prioritize?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0146

--
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for LLMs
From: Sarah Langford <sarah.langford@finflow.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@finflow.com, IT Security <it-security@finflow.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & marketplace options

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement preference: We generally prefer AWS Marketplace (subscription) when available because it maps to our existing invoice/chargeback flows. That said, for pilot projects we sometimes accept a PO to accelerate legal sign-off if marketplace onboarding will take longer than 3–4 weeks.
- Security: IT Security has one or two standard questions around data residency and audit logs — they are cc'd here.
- Finance: Procurement will need an itemized cost breakdown (unit price per token or per request, expected billing cadence) and a short statement of work for the pilot.

I attached our internal procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.xlsx) which lists required documents and lead times.

Next steps for us: we'll evaluate marketplace vs PO case-by-case. For this pilot, please send the SLA draft and a proposed pilot SOW + estimated monthly spend so we can flag any items that need escalations.

Regards,
Sarah Langford
Head of Product Ops, FinFlow
sarah.langford@finflow.com

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14 KB)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & marketplace options

Karthik / Marissa —

Quick internal note: if FinFlow goes Marketplace, we need to confirm the following before we commit to listing:
- Marketplace SKU and price band mapping for token tiers (we should propose 0–5M, 5–20M, 20M+ buckets).
- Whether we support SaaS Contract through AWS Marketplace (metered/subscription) vs private offers.
- Expected go-live time: our typical catalog onboarding is ~2–3 weeks for standard accounts but can be longer if custom legal review is needed.

If procurement chooses PO route, Marissa can prioritize a SOW template + invoice cadence. I can scope the token-pricing matrix and expected throughput targets for the pilot.

Dev
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Langford <sarah.langford@finflow.com>, procurement@finflow.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-22T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & marketplace options

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the checklist. Attaching a short SLA draft (redwood-sla-draft.pdf) and an internal marketplace onboarding checklist for your procurement team. High-level commercial options (for the pilot):

A) AWS Marketplace subscription (recommended)
- Billing: monthly subscription billed through Marketplace; FinFlow's finance team receives consolidated invoice.
- Timing: marketplace onboarding + legal review ~2–4 weeks typical.
- Pros: aligns with internal procurement, faster approvals for future expansions.

B) Paper PO + Invoice (alternative)
- Billing: Redwood issues monthly invoices against PO / SOW; Net30 typical unless otherwise agreed.
- Timing: SOW + PO turnaround dependent on procurement (can be 1–3 weeks).
- Pros: can be faster for pilot if marketplace onboarding is blocked; allows negotiated SLA changes.

C) Card / Self-serve (not recommended for this buyer profile)

Please confirm which path you prefer. If Marketplace: can you share FinFlow's AWS Account ID and Buyer contact so we can start the AWS SaaS listing workflow? If PO: please send your standard PO template and the contact who will sign the SOW.

Attachments: redwood-sla-draft.pdf (12 pages), marketplace-onboarding-steps.docx (checklist)

Also: linking a DocuSign starter for the SOW if you want to expedite: https://app.docusign.com/starter/REDWOOD-FF-1347

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: procurement@finflow.com <procurement@finflow.com>

Cc: IT Security <it-security@finflow.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & marketplace options

Karthik / Redwood team —

Thanks for the materials. Procurement has discussed internally and our current preference is to pursue AWS Marketplace SaaS subscription for the pilot, provided the onboarding timeline meets our 3–4 week window.

Requests before we kick off marketplace onboarding:
- Please provide an itemized estimate for the pilot (expected monthly spend range) and the SKU mapping Dev mentioned.
- Confirm data handling language for audit logs / retention in the SLA (we will share IT Security comments separately).
- Please share the AWS Account ID / Buyer contact and any required AWS registration forms.

We will also keep PO as a fallback if Marketplace onboarding stalls beyond our timeline. Looping in IT Security to coordinate a short review.

Procurement contact: Maria Gomez <procurement@finflow.com>

Regards,
FinFlow Procurement
